description.short_caption: Erythema and swelling of the plantar surface of the foot.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the plantar surface of a foot with diffuse erythema and mild swelling. The redness is more pronounced on the medial aspect, and there is no visible ulceration or open wound. The surrounding skin appears intact, and the toes are visible in the upper part of the image. The patient is positioned on a medical examination table.
visible_findings: diffuse erythema on the plantar surface

description.short_caption: Diffuse petechial rash on the lower extremity.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the lateral aspect of a lower extremity with a diffuse, non-blanching petechial rash. The rash consists of numerous small, red to purple macules distributed across the skin. The background skin appears otherwise unremarkable, and there is no visible swelling or ulceration. The patient is positioned on a white sheet, suggesting a clinical setting.
